functions.name: has_role
functions.definition: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION has_role(user_id UUID, role_name TEXT) RETURNS BOOLEAN AS $$ BEGIN RETURN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM user_roles WHERE user_id = $1 AND role_type = $2); END; $$ LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER;
functions.description: ユーザーが指定ロールを持っているかチェック

functions.name: has_permission
functions.definition: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION has_permission(user_id UUID, permission_name TEXT) RETURNS BOOLEAN AS $$ DECLARE role_record RECORD; permission_exists BOOLEAN := FALSE; BEGIN FOR role_record IN SELECT role_type FROM user_roles WHERE user_id = $1 LOOP IF role_record.role_type = 'admin' THEN RETURN TRUE; END IF; SELECT TRUE INTO permission_exists FROM ( VALUES ('user', ARRAY['users:read:self', 'schedule:read', 'schedule:write:self']), ('viewer', ARRAY['schedule:read']) ) AS role_permissions(role_name, permissions) WHERE role_name = role_record.role_type AND $2 = ANY(permissions); IF permission_exists THEN RETURN TRUE; END IF; END LOOP; RETURN FALSE; END; $$ LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER;
functions.description: ユーザーが指定権限を持っているかチェック

functions.name: get_user_effective_roles
functions.definition: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION get_user_effective_roles(user_id UUID) RETURNS TEXT[] AS $$ DECLARE roles TEXT[]; BEGIN SELECT ARRAY_AGG(role_type) INTO roles FROM user_roles WHERE user_id = $1; RETURN COALESCE(roles, ARRAY[]::TEXT[]); END; $$ LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER;
functions.description: ユーザーの実効ロール一覧を取得

functions.name: get_user_effective_permissions
functions.definition: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION get_user_effective_permissions(user_id UUID) RETURNS TEXT[] AS $$ DECLARE permissions TEXT[] := ARRAY[]::TEXT[]; role_record RECORD; BEGIN FOR role_record IN SELECT role_type FROM user_roles WHERE user_id = $1 LOOP IF role_record.role_type = 'admin' THEN permissions := permissions || ARRAY['users:read', 'users:write', 'users:delete', 'roles:read', 'roles:write', 'schedule:read', 'schedule:write', 'schedule:delete', 'admin:manage']; ELSIF role_record.role_type = 'user' THEN permissions := permissions || ARRAY['users:read:self', 'schedule:read', 'schedule:write:self']; ELSIF role_record.role_type = 'viewer' THEN permissions := permissions || ARRAY['schedule:read']; END IF; END LOOP; RETURN array_remove(array_remove(permissions, NULL), ''); END; $$ LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER;
functions.description: ユーザーの実効権限一覧を取得
